newsitem.title: USA: RTRS - Snyder Oil to post gain from Command deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Snyder Oil to post gain from Command deal.

text.p: Snyder Oil Corp said on Wednesday it expects to report a pre-tax gain of US$60 million upon closing of Cairn Energy Plc's merger with Command Petroleum Holdings NL.
Snyder holds 32.6 percent, or 105 million shares, in Command and its SOCO Australia unit has granted approval for Cairn to acquire 19.9 percent of Command shares.
It is expected that, in the absence of a higher bid, Snyder would accept Cairn's offer for all of its Command shares as soon as the offer becomes unconditional, Snyder said.
Snyder's SOCO unit has already elected to receive Cairn stock for the shares under option and anticipates it will elect to receive its entire consideration in stock.
Based on current stock prices and exchange rates, SOCO's stake in Command has a value based on the Cairn offer of approximately US$95 million.
No taxes are expected to be payable by SOCO on the transaction. However, a deferred tax provision will be provided in its financial statements.
